events.verdict: Sabonis (SAC) makes contact to the ball and incidental contact with Gill's (WAS) hand on the ball that dislodges it from his possession.
Johnson (WAS) lowers his arm and initiates illegal contact with LaVine's (SAC) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Carrington (WAS) lowers his arm into DeRozan's (SAC) head during the driving shot attempt and the contact is more than marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) jumps to contest Johnson's (WAS) driving shot attempt with an arm extended and the contact after Johnson's release is marginal.

Johnson (WAS) moves laterally into DeRozan (SAC) after he gathers the ball and initiates illegal arm and body contact during the driving shot attempt. Since the illegal contact occurs after DeRozan's gather, continuation is correctly awarded.
Vukcevic (WAS) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by DeRozan (SAC) during his shot attempt.
LaVine (SAC) extends his arm into Carrington (WAS), affecting his SQBR.
Champagnie (WAS) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm.
Vukcevic (WAS) briefly has an arm wrapped around Sabonis (SAC) as he deflects the rebound away.
Gill (WAS) does not maintain a vertical position and makes contact to DeRozan's (SAC) arm that affects his shot attempt.
LaVine (SAC) reaches in and makes illegal contact to Champagnie's (WAS) arm.
Champagnie (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position and avoids making any contact as he contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
There is no clear and conclusive evidence that confirms the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and therefore, play resumes with a jump ball at center circle.
